environment.virtualizer: same locally patched QEMU 11.1.3 WHPX build as v8; isolated socket Ethernet

method.tcp: two independent native AWG clients at 50 Mbit/s each, 8 measured seconds after 1 warmup, 5% tolerance per client
method.cpu: complete nominal 250-ms marked intervals; sliding four-sample tick sums; collectors included; no new SSH/sudo within windows
method.busy_definition: user+nice+system+irq+softirq divided by first eight /proc/stat counters including idle/iowait/steal
method.noise: 300000 UDP packets targeting 25000/s over 12 seconds, one flow, one random 256-byte payload per trial, offered bursts up to 4096
method.rate_gate: source mean within 1%, entry delivery within 1%, zero switch drops; all offered packets counted independently at switch
method.stability_scope: repeatable twelve-second means and retained burst/100-ms arrival traces; offered burst workload is not flat instantaneous 25000/s
method.sequence: original noise-only and direction screens; fixed repeats; revert to original noise-only; fixed rotated primary matrix, mobility, clean and DNAT references
method.unchanged: native switch, guest kernels, filter keys/crypto checks, guard 50k/5000 aggregate and 35k/3500 tuple, collector and noise workload; no IFB
method.queue_followup: after carrier fix, old 2048-packet NFQUEUE overflowed under unchanged bursts; only its bound and startup telemetry changed to 4096 for separate final repeats
method.host_cpu_reference: per-process percent of one Windows logical CPU, independent of whole-VM CPU; 32 logical CPUs on host
method.public_data: checked aggregates/worst windows and arrival bins; raw resident/host/burst traces retained locally

root_cause.path: QEMU net/socket.c net_socket_receive -> util/iov.c non-POSIX piecewise fallback
root_cause.before: one send for 4-byte frame length, another for Ethernet payload with TCP_NODELAY
root_cause.after: Windows-only contiguous prefix+payload buffer and one send attempt; same offset/error/partial-write handling
root_cause.TCP_semantics: one send does not guarantee one segment or one recv; length-prefixed stream format and parser unchanged
root_cause.control: unpatched function fails single-write unit assertion, patched function passes; rate shortfall returns in a reverted-VM control
